items.title: India PM Narendra Modi Shares Viral GTA 6 vs GTA 5 Meme

candidate_claims.text: Home › News › GTA 6 India PM Narendra Modi Shares Viral GTA 6 vs GTA 5 Meme Levelling up.

By Tom Phillips Updated : Nov 19, 2026 4:57pm UTC Add IGN on Google 0 3 Prime Minister Narendra Modi has joined the GTA 6 launch hype with a viral meme highlighting how far India has levelled up since GTA 5 came out in 2013.

Tapping into the internet's running joke about the 13-year gap between GTA 5 and GTA 6, Modi shared a 10-slide carousel of GTA-styled graphics on Twitter/X and Instagram this morning, framing India's development over the past decade as a real-world upgrade.

"India is playing a whole new game!" Modi wrote alongside the post, titled "Between GTA 5 and 6, here's how India upgraded." Styled after Rockstar's renowned loading-screen art (although sadly quite obviously created using AI), the graphics contrast the country in 2013 and 2026 — highlighting falling mobile data prices, surging solar power capacity, and a drastic fall in extreme poverty.

https://t.co/CMkMbK6vII — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 19, 2026 India is now the world's fastest-growing major economy, the post stated, boasting vastly improved statistics for the country's sanitation, the electrification of its railroads, and a sharp fall in domestic far-left teorrism.
